primitives.name: Closing-Line Value (CLV)
primitives.verbatim_quote: Classifies a pick on calibrated P + edge + CLV history.
primitives.assumptions: ['The pick has settled with a binary outcome (win = $1, lose = $0)', 'Closing odds are accurate at the time the bet was placed', 'No transaction costs or vig are considered in this pure metric']
primitives.breakdown_regime: CLV approaches -1 when the pick loses and +∞ when the pick wins at high odds

layer2.mapping: GSI: The CLV serves as a conformal p-value for the null hypothesis that the pick's probability estimate is well-calibrated. GSE: It quantifies the realized information gain relative to the market's closing expectation, enabling optimal scaling of future bets.
layer2.telemetry: Average CLV per pick, CLV distribution skewness, correlation between predicted probability and observed CLV

layer2.telemetry: Tier distribution across picks, average CLV by tier, rate of transition between conviction levels
